name: tiab-review-plugin
description: TiAb Review Plugin - Chrome拡張機能 for Systematic Review のスクリーニング

scripts.build:zip: webpack --mode production && powershell -Command "[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Content .env -Encoding UTF8 | ForEach-Object { if($_ -match '^([^#][^=]*)=(.*)$') { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($matches[1], $matches[2]) } }; Compress-Archive -Path ./dist/* -DestinationPath ./dist.zip -Force; Copy-Item ./dist.zip (Join-Path $env:DIST_COPY_PATH 'dist.zip') -Force"
